name: deployment_canary_guard
description: Port of ole-eval code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/deployment_canary_guard. Ordered REJECT rules for hard policy caps (dangerous tokens, malformed stages, cap violations) first; soft risk 30-70 escalates; else APPROVE.

service_name_safe.instructions: Is the service_name free of dangerous tokens (eval(, exec(, subprocess, os.system, javascript:, data:, rm -rf, ...)?

health_path_safe.instructions: Is the health_check_path free of dangerous tokens?

criteria.B: no, at least one stage exceeds

rollback_threshold_ok.instructions: Is error_rate <= max_error_rate (default 0.05) AND latency_p99_ms <= max_latency_p99_ms (default 5000)?

criteria.B: no, one of them is over

stage_shape_ok.instructions: Is the stages list non-empty and <= max_stages (default 10), with non-negative percent and hold_minutes?

criteria.B: no, a stage holds too long

risk.instructions: Overall risky-canary risk 0-100 (stage count, hold magnitude, rollback severity, dangerous tokens).
